title: Ranked scene matches
description: Acquisitions ranked by visual similarity, emitted by `umbra embed similar --json` (an acquisition as the query) and `umbra embed search --json` (a text query), which differ only in what `query` holds. Every field of a match except `score` was recorded at build time from the deterministic item, so a match is a pointer back to a real acquisition rather than a model-authored fact. Empty `matches` means nothing cleared the score threshold.

query.description: What was searched for: the query text for `umbra embed search`, or the query acquisition's item id for `umbra embed similar`.

matches.description: The acquisitions that cleared the threshold, closest first.

item_id.description: The matched acquisition's STAC item id.

score.description: Cosine similarity to the query, rounded to six places: 1.0 identical, 0.0 unrelated, higher is closer.

task.description: The task/site the acquisition belongs to, recorded when the embedding was built. Null when the indexed item carried none.

datetime.description: When it was acquired, ISO 8601, recorded at build time. Null when the indexed item carried none.

href.description: The acquisition's STAC item URL — what every `umbra` command that takes a scene accepts, so a match can be acted on directly. Null when the indexed item carried none.
